title: Stair Ways
statement_md: A fighter climbs a staircase of $n$ steps, taking either 1 or 2 steps at a time. In how many different ways can they reach the top? Print the answer modulo $1\,000\,000\,007$.
output_md: Print the number of ways modulo $10^9 + 7$.
hints: Pattern: dynamic programming over the step number.
The last move was a 1-step or a 2-step, so ways(n) = ways(n-1) + ways(n-2).

a, b = 1, 1
for _ in range(n - 1):
    a, b = b, (a + b) % MOD
print(b)

reference_solution:
MOD = 10**9 + 7


def main():
    n = int(input())
    a, b = 1, 1
    for _ in range(n - 1):
        a, b = b, (a + b) % MOD
    print(b)


main()
